data.name: Samirul
data.gender_notes: Samirul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has calm and cool mind, rules over his senses and emotions. The name Samirul carries the meaning “Calm, Cool, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Samirul usually hope their child will grow to embody calm, cool, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a spiritual seeker who wants to rule over his senses and emotions, and maintain calmness and composure in all situations.
data.etymology: Samirul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Calm, Cool, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samirul total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Samirul" is of Hindu origin and is derived from the Sanskrit word "Sami," which means calm, peace, or tranquility. The suffix "ul" in this name denotes one who possesses or rules over that quality. In ancient Hindu culture, the ability to maintain a calm and peaceful mind was considered a great virtue and a sign of deep inner wisdom. Samirul may have been a respected and revered person in his community, often sought for his counsel and guidance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Samirul holds significant spiritual significance, as it reflects the ideal state of a seeker of the divine. A calm and peaceful mind is essential for deep contemplation, meditation, and inner growth. By being one who rules over his senses and emotions, Samirul embodies self-discipline, self-control, and the ability to detach from worldly distractions. These qualities enhance spiritual practice and help one to connect more deeply with the divine within. Thus, Samirul serves as an inspiration for those seeking inner peace and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Samirul: Calm Seeker of Truth Eternal quest for inner peace amidst the chaos of life. Dwelling in the tranquil depths of one's being.
